name: Beach Laundry
description: Beach Laundry has been serving the Orange Beach community for many years. As of July 2021 it is under new ownership. We are now offering pickup and delivery service through HappyNest. Go to HappyNest.com to schedule. We manage 6 laundromats in Mobile and Baldwin counties. With our purchase of Beach Laundry in July 2021, we are excited to bring our expertise of the laundry business to customers in our beach community. We have a full-time attendant Monday-Friday 8:30-4:00 who can assist you with your laundry needs. We are also conveniently open 24/7 for self-service.
